binary-data/xml.reason: DataValue is a Go string; CBOR encoding emits text instead of a definite byte string (RFC 8428 section 6).

base-value-inheritance/xml.reason: Normalize applies bv only from the current record and omits its inherited value in later records.

base-value-reset/xml.reason: omitempty drops explicit bv=0 from the raw encoding, changing later resolution.

base-name-reset/xml.reason: An empty bn is treated as absent, retaining the preceding base name.

base-time-reset/xml.reason: An explicit bt=0 is treated as absent, retaining the preceding base time.

base-unit-reset/xml.reason: An explicit empty unit/base unit is treated as absent, retaining the preceding base unit.

unit-empty-override/xml.reason: An explicit empty unit/base unit is treated as absent, retaining the preceding base unit.

base-sum-inheritance/xml.reason: Normalize only emits s when a regular s was present; the inherited bs alone is lost.

base-sum-reset/xml.reason: An explicit bs=0 is treated as absent, retaining the preceding base sum.

relative-time/xml.reason: An explicit bt=0 is treated as absent, retaining the preceding base time.

context-record/xml.reason: The base-only context record, as in RFC 8428 section 5.1.7, is rejected for lacking a value.

mandatory-extension/xml.reason: Unknown underscore-suffixed labels are ignored instead of rejected (RFC 8428 section 4.4).

unknown-version/xml.reason: Go carries bver=99 without an unsupported-feature check; SenWeave currently supports version 10.

integer-53/xml.reason: Go uses binary64 and loses exact integer representation. Binary64 equivalence is checked separately; exact integer preservation is an additional SenWeave capability.

uint64-max/xml.reason: Go uses binary64 and loses exact integer representation. Binary64 equivalence is checked separately; exact integer preservation is an additional SenWeave capability.

negative-cbor-min/xml.reason: Go JSON formatting changes the spelling of -2^64; its XML formatter preserves the integer in this sample. Binary64 equivalence is recorded separately.

base-value-on-sum/xml.reason: Normalize does not apply bv when a sum-only measurement has no regular v (RFC 8428 section 4.5.4).

xml-all-labels/xml.reason: Combined fixture exposes lost explicit base resets, inherited sums without regular s, CBOR DataValue text encoding and float64 representation. Individual causes have separate minimal fixtures.

xml-integral-version-lexical/xml.reason: XML Schema int permits a leading plus and leading zeros; Go uint XML parsing rejects +010.

xml-duplicate-attributes/xml.reason: Go XML decoding accepts duplicate attributes, which XML 1.0 forbids; SenWeave reports InvalidXml.

xml-foreign-root-namespace/xml.reason: Go matches the root local name without enforcing the SenML namespace URI.

xml-dtd-ingress/xml.reason: Go skips the DTD directive. SenWeave rejects DTD declarations as an explicit ingress policy.

xml-empty-values/xml.reason: An empty DataValue remains a string in Go CBOR output instead of a definite-length byte string.

content-format-inheritance/xml.reason: The pinned Go model discards bct and then rejects the base-only context as an empty-name record. RFC 9193 base-context semantics are not implemented.

content-format-parameters/xml.reason: The pinned Go model has no ct/bct fields. Raw encodings discard them and Normalize does not materialize binary content-format inheritance.

content-format-number-boundary/xml.reason: The pinned Go model discards bct and then rejects the base-only context as an empty-name record. RFC 9193 base-context semantics are not implemented.

content-format-base-replacement/xml.reason: The pinned Go model has no ct/bct fields. Raw encodings discard them and Normalize does not materialize binary content-format inheritance.

content-format-out-of-range/xml.reason: The pinned Go model discards ct and accepts this input without RFC 9193 syntax, type or binary-value validation.

content-format-without-data/xml.reason: The pinned Go model discards ct and accepts this input without RFC 9193 syntax, type or binary-value validation.

content-format-empty-base/xml.reason: Both reject, but Go reports empty name after discarding bct; it does not validate the invalid empty content format.
